verdict.rationale: Slate is a general coding agent that runs long sessions and parallel task orchestration, and its docs say it can perform integration tests manually. That is the only part of the story with direct, testing-related evidence; none of the four named maintenance tasks is explicitly documented. missing for 10: documented test-writing capability, lint-error fixing, merge-conflict resolution, dependency updating, and hands-on corroboration of any of these.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent write tests, fix lint errors, resolve merge conflicts, and update dependencies for me

citations.quote: Slate is one of the few agents capable of performing integration tests manually.
spin up more agents to parallelize work across several tasks at once
